class_order: Grade 0: No radiographic OA (Normal joint space, no osteophytes)
Grade 1: Doubtful OA (Possible osteophytic lipping, doubtful joint space narrowing)
Grade 2: Mild radiographic OA (Definite osteophytes, possible joint space narrowing)
Grade 3: Moderate radiographic OA (Multiple osteophytes, definite joint space narrowing, some sclerosis)
Grade 4: Severe radiographic OA (Large osteophytes, marked joint space narrowing, severe sclerosis)
selected_champion_model.selection_rationale: Demonstrated the highest 5-class test macro F1 (0.6724) among all architectures, superior KL1 performance over Experiment E (0.347 vs 0.289), strong severe OA recall (88.24% KL4 recall), and balanced clinical screening specificity (88.66% at threshold 0.30).

alternative_research_candidate.notes: Higher KL2 and KL4 sensitivity through micro-scaling and edge sharpness, but exhibited lower KL1 sensitivity compared to Experiment D. Retained for future ensemble research.
